You cannot assume data_len is valid (or any other network data for that matter!). Say its value is such that in this loop it decreases so that it goes negative; then the loop continues. This has to check for data_len > 0.

General question: What if the capture is frame-sliced? Shouldn't all calls
to read from the tvb be checked to see if sufficient bytes exist before
each call?

Function smb_get_unicode_or_ascii_string() is a handy general-purpose
routine (not specific to SMB or SMB2). Should it be moved to strutil.c? If
so, the source code to the two functions it calls could be included in the
smb_get_unicode_or_ascii_string() source.

I should have added that I've made the change you recommended (data_len >
0). Thx

changed this line in [version 24 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19489/diffs?diff_id=1326362594&start_sha=a3ab63ba8cc9a5701f23272cf0ce8d06e965c9be#66fe24dd8943889e250c62afccceae1511df40ef_9163_9151)

The common function to read from tvb:s are meant to throw exception on trys to read outside of the buffer.

Values fetched from packets runs the risk of having random values.

General string handling functions that may be useful elsewhere belongs in strutil.c
These names are too generic to insert in the global namespace. Add some sort of SMB designator to it.

Okay. I changed the name to smb_get_unicode_or_ascii_string(). I was able
to remove *unicode_to_str*() and find_unicode_null_offset() from the SMB
header file because although  smb_get_unicode_or_ascii_string() calls them,
they don't need to be extern'ed in that file (as long as they are not
static). I didn't realize that. I'm not pushing a new commit until tomorrow.

commits_data.message:
SMB2: Added subdissector for FSCTL_DFS_GET_REFERRALS_EX

Changed "while (datalen)" to "while (data_len > 0)".

Added "smb" to the names of the three ett's.

Removed dissect_smb2_FSCTL_DFS_GET_REFERRALS_EX from packet-smb.h
that since that dissector is in packet-smb2.c.

I have a capture and all the above work fine.
